plans.title: ASR boundary: load Fun-ASR-Nano locally and keep its native punctuation
notes: Hotfix path (specify-min -> plan-min -> implement) on operator request: use Nano's native punctuation and E2E one video.
D1 the pinned Nano checkpoint has no FunASR alias (remote-code model) and could not load; a local snapshot directory loads it with trust_remote_code=False.
D2 the call sent use_itn plus VAD-only kwargs and language='auto', which becomes the prompt fragment 语音转写成auto：.
D3 normalize_result understood neither Nano's token timestamps (seconds, punctuation tokens included) nor its cue granularity.
D4 no VAD: a 448 s recording decodes to one character ('。') in both call shapes; the same audio behind fsmn-vad returns 2227 chars / 2064 token timestamps.
D5 the CLI's confined descriptor path is close-on-exec, so ffmpeg (used by the VAD component) could not open it; the boundary now materializes such an input into a temporary file.
Live E2E on the GPU box: BV1wLTP6NE9h:p0 archived in 3m40s (rtf 0.444), 124 non-overlapping cues, TXT 2251 chars with 。×90 ，×116 ？×17.
QA gate: pm-acceptance (hotfix path); full suite 1326 passed / 4 skipped at the final HEAD.

reconcile_note: Snapshot contract fix 2026-09-28: an empty-string compass_ref was removed. This lifecycle is `type: plan` (a standalone delivery), not an iteration — it has no iteration compass, and the validator's rule is 'if present, non-empty'. An earlier pass in this session wrote a fabricated iteration-compass path here; that value was wrong and is withdrawn. A dangling empty-string key was what made the snapshot unreadable, not a missing compass.
